How to translate an EPUB file

Upload an EPUB you have permission to process, select the source and target languages, and review the translation settings. Confirm the file-specific quote before payment. Processing runs on the server; return to the task center in the same browser to download the EPUB.

English, Japanese, Korean and Chinese ebook translation

Translate in either direction between English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese: 20 distinct language pairs. For example, translate a Japanese EPUB into English or an English EPUB into Korean. Chinese character conversion alone is a separate basic service, not a full AI translation.

Bilingual EPUB and terminology

Choose bilingual output to read the original alongside the translation, or supply a glossary for names and technical terms. The workflow processes chapters and the table of contents and checks the output. Review important passages, numbers and specialist terminology against the original; AI translation can make mistakes.

Translation price and PayPal

Translation has a file-specific quote; the basic US$0.99 conversion price does not cover AI translation. PayPal AI orders have a US$1.49 minimum, not a fixed whole-book price. The displayed USD total includes payment fees. Review the final amount before deciding to pay.

Which ebook formats can I translate?

EPUB, TXT, DOCX, MD and Markdown are supported, with EPUB output. Convert MOBI or AZW3 to a supported format first. PDF translation, scanned-page OCR and text embedded in image pixels are not supported. Protected or unparseable files cannot be processed.

Can I close the page after paying?

Yes. Processing continues on the server. Use the original browser and task center to check progress and download the result. Do not pay again to recover an existing task; contact support with the task ID if needed.
